catalog_quote: Stress is realized in Nedebang primarily by means of duration. In words without geminate consonants, vowels of stressed syllables, regardless of whether they are open or closed, are longer. In words with a geminate consonant, stress is attracted to the syllable with the geminate onset. In these syllables, the vowel is not lengthened. Stress in Nedebang is phonemic. Minimal pairs found in my database demonstrating the contrast are presented in (27). In these disyllabic words, the stress difference is apparent through the length of the vowel on the first versus second syllables. No stress-differentiated minimal pairs are found for 3- or 4-syllable words. [...] /aˈɸa/ [ʔaɸaː] ‘dream’ ≠ /ˈaɸa/ [ʔaːɸa] ‘fathom’ [...] In disyllabic words, diphthongs are always stressed. [...] In 3- and 4-syllable words with diphthongs, stress placement is unpredictable. Diphthongs count as long and show no lengthening under stress. [...] Although contrastive, the overwhelmingly majority pattern is for words without geminates and diphthongs to have penultimate stress. Approximately 80%–90% of words consisting only of light syllables (i.e., (C)VCV or (C)VCVCV and even (C)VCVCVCV) have penultimate stress. In the same way, disyllabic words with a final coda (i.e., the shape (C)VCVC) almost all have penultimate stress; only four out of 33 items have final stress. Almost all 3- and 4-syllable words without a geminate consonant also have stress on the penultimate syllable.

new_statements.rule_in_words: Stress is contrastive (seven disyllabic minimal pairs such as /aˈɸa/ 'dream' vs /ˈaɸa/ 'fathom'), cued mainly by vowel length. The strong default is penultimate stress (80-90% of words made of light syllables; almost all (C)VCVC disyllables, 29 of 33; almost all 3-4 syllable words without geminates). Two attractors override the default: a syllable with a geminate onset takes the stress (without vowel lengthening), and in disyllables a diphthong is always stressed (initial or final). In 3-4 syllable words containing diphthongs, placement is unpredictable.
new_statements.secondary_stress: A weak secondary stress occurs in trisyllabic words whose primary stress is final or initial (e.g. /qulanˈda/ [ˌqulanˈdaː] 'snore', /ˈhamajan/ [ˈhaːmaˌjan] 'your beard'), and initially on 4-syllable words, all of which have penultimate primary stress (e.g. [ˌtonuˈgasi] 'worm').
new_statements.exceptions: Final stress in 4 of 33 (C)VCVC disyllables; 3-4 syllable words with diphthongs have unpredictable stress; obligatory agreement prefixes, applicative wa- and dummy-object i- are outside the stress domain and never stressed (/ga-θaŋ/ [gaˈθaːŋ]); optional agreement prefixes attract stress on monosyllabic roots ([ˈgaːma] 'make come') but not on multisyllabic roots ([gaˈkaːraŋ]).
new_statements.domain_note: Word-level (lexical roots plus prefixation) in elicited citation forms from Schapper's database (1027-item lexicon, 836 sentences), speakers worked with in Kalabahi 2015-2019; diphthongs 'count as long and show no lengthening under stress'; no phrase-level statement.
new_statements.identity_note: Schapper 2020 describes Nedebang (ISO 639-3 nec; some speakers prefer the name Klamu), the language of the villages Baolang, Balungada and Air Panas in north Pantar; data elicited in Kalabahi 2015-2019 with six named speakers. This is the language-level languoid nede1245; no dialect distinction is made.

sources.note: The paper says nothing about word stress, accent or tone: no occurrence of 'stress', 'accent', 'tone', 'pitch', 'prosody' or 'intonation' anywhere in the six pages. Section 2 (Phonology) covers the consonant inventory, the (marginal) geminate contrast (yila 'water' vs yilla 'to fly', p. 2), the five-vowel system and three diphthongs, CV(C) syllable structure with codas limited to /r l ng/, and the CV minimal word. tone.quote: Data digali dengan menjaring 200 kosakata Swadesh. Berdasarkan hasil penelitian fonem vokal bahasa Nedebang ditemukan berjumlah lima buah yakni: /a/, /i/, /u/, /e/, dan /o/. Fonem-fonem tersebut memiliki distribusi lengkap yakni pada posisi awal, tengah, dan akhir. [...] Selanjutnya bahasa Nedebang memiliki konsonan sebanyak dua puluh fonem, yakni:/b/,/p/,/m/,/d/,/v/,/f/,/t/,/s/,/r/,/n/,/ŋ/,/l/, /k/,/g/, /Ɂ/,/j/,/c/,/h/,/w/, dan /y/.
tone.locator: Abstrak, first page of the article; scope statement only - the article has no tone or stress passage
tone.translation: The data were gathered by eliciting the 200-item Swadesh list. According to the results, Nedebang has five vowel phonemes, /a i u e o/, each with full distribution (initial, medial, final position). [...] Further, Nedebang has twenty consonant phonemes: /b p m d v f t s r n ŋ l k g ʔ j c h w y/.

tone.quote: Hasilnya, Bahasa Nedebang memiliki delapan belas bunyi konsonan, delapan bunyi vokal, sembilan bunyi diftong, dan lima belas konsonan rangkap. Bahasa Nedebang juga memiliki tujuh pola suku kata yang tersusun dalam satuan-satuan kata sari yang sederhana hingga kompleks.

tone.translation: As a result, Nedebang has eighteen consonant sounds, eight vowel sounds, nine diphthongs and fifteen geminate (double) consonants. Nedebang also has seven syllable patterns arranged in word units from simple to complex.
